posts.title: Introducing Star Wars in Age of Empires II DE
posts.description: This project is in beta, AI disclaimer Here it is in AOE II DE! You can set it up yourself with this GitHub - play against the Rebel Alliance or Empire, and even with friends! You will need AOE II DE, Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds, and Expanding Fronts. Something you may not know is that Star Wars is already in the AOE II engine.
